title: shorea disticha
intro: Shorea disticha, commonly known as the White Meranti, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. The health benefits of Shorea disticha include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it useful for treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Shorea disticha include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
